customManagers.description: Track Docker images nested in a workflow ${{ }} expression. The built-in github-actions manager does extract service images, but getDep skips any value containing '$' with skipReason 'contains-variable', so a conditional service image needs this manager to stay updated.
Track the actionlint container tag used by the justfile lint recipe
Track the prettier version used by the justfile fmt and fmt-check recipes

packageRules.description: The shared preset turns off digest pinning for custom.regex docker deps, since those managers usually capture a version only. The workflow-expression manager captures currentDigest too, so pinning is re-enabled for it. Every custom.regex manager reports as `custom.regex`, so matchManagers cannot single one out; matchFileNames is the only selector, and it must name the files the expression manager actually reads. A broader `.github/workflows/**` glob also caught the inherited `# renovate:` comment manager (e.g. KUBESEC_IMAGE_VERSION in security-config.yml), whose matchStrings have no currentDigest group, producing `Digest is not updated` and a failed branch. Repo-level rules are merged after preset ones, so this wins.

Self-reference: this repo pins its own composite actions by date tag (e.g. `actions/project/action.yml` -> `actions/setup-dde@<DATE-TAG>`). `merge.yml` moves a `YYYY-MM-DD` tag on every push to main, and the pin has to track the current tag: `actions/project` resolves `actions/setup-dde` through it, so any lag here rides into consumers. The preset now batches this dep's rollout to a Monday window, which is right for consumers and wrong here - a tag cut on Tuesday would not reach this pin until the following Monday. An `at any time` schedule opts this repo out of that window; `minimumReleaseAge: null` restates the preset's own value so the intent survives a future change to it. An own branch is required alongside it, and `groupSlug` is what creates one: Renovate derives the branch from `slugify(groupSlug ?? groupName)` and evaluates `schedule` per branch, while packageRules merge last-wins per key - so the preset's `groupSlug: all-non-major` (a tag bump is a minor under the date-tag regex versioning) survives a bare `groupName` here and would keep the self-reference on `renovate/all-non-major` with that branch's window. Consumers get the preset's Monday window instead of this one; batching the rollout there is the point.
